title: On n-distality, n-triviality and hypergraph regularity in NIP theories
summary: We study Keisler measures in strongly n-distal NIP theories, generalizing some results of Simon and Chernikov-Starchenko for distal theories and addressing some questions of Walker. In particular, we establish a hypergraph version of the distal regularity lemma, compact domination for definable fsg groups, and demonstrate that the strong n-distality hierarchy is strict among stable theories using a connection to Poizat's total triviality of forking.
